description.description: Centralized event discovery for IIT Delhi: students otherwise track ~39 club Instagram accounts manually.
Frontend and ingestion are decoupled; Firestore is the only contract between them.
Flyers are images, so OCR/vision extraction is required to obtain structured event fields.
GitHub Actions cron avoids running any always-on server.
Strict theme tokens instead of ad-hoc styles keeps mobile and web visually identical.
Canonical seed list of scrape targets, grouped by Boards / Clubs / Fests / Admin / Technical.
Second, drifted copy of the handle directory (41 handles vs 45 in docs/; @enactus_iitd vs @enactus_iitdelhi).
Hardcoded 27-handle subset curated by hand from the 45-entry docs directory.
responseSchema + temperature 0.0 forces deterministic JSON with a confidenceScore for downstream triage.
Low-confidence extractions are queued for human curation rather than published blindly.
Only integration point between the Python/Node scraper and the Expo client.
No backend server exists, so the app calls the Gemini REST API directly with an EXPO_PUBLIC_ key and a three-model fallback chain.
Kerberos ID profile is stored on-device only; no Firebase Auth, so it is claimed, not verified.
Anti-'AI slop' aesthetic rules the app's theme layer is meant to satisfy.
Design-system generator guidance (palettes, font pairings, React Native stack rules) used to derive the theme tokens.
Apify supplies Instagram access, Cloudinary hosts flyer/avatar images so Firestore stores only URLs.
